base_length = 80.0

inner_width = base_width - 2 * frame_thickness
hole_diameter = 5.5

inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0

step2_radius = step2_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((outer_radius, 0), (outer_radius, length), (step2_radius, length),
                     (step2_radius, length - step2_length), (step1_radius, length - step2_length),
                     (step1_radius, length - step2_length - step1_length),
                     (inner_radius, length - step2_length - step1_length),
                     (inner_radius, 0), close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges(), chamfer_size)

hole_cyl = Pos(outer_radius - mount_hole_offset, 0, length / 2) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter / 2, length)
solid_body = solid_body - hole_cyl
